passages.note: Martinez is listed as a co-sponsor of HB2853 (2022), the Arizona empowerment scholarship accounts bill, during her first House term.
The House Third Reading roll call shows Martinez voting Y on final passage of HB2853 (2022), which passed 31-26-3-0-0.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: The enacted bill adds section 15-2401.01, making any resident eligible to attend a public preschool-disability program, kindergarten, or grades 1-12 a qualified student, i.e., a universal ESA expansion.

rows.reasoning: Martinez co-sponsored and voted Y on final passage of HB2853 (2022), a single-subject Arizona empowerment scholarship accounts bill. Its enacted text adds section 15-2401.01, making any resident eligible to enroll in a public preschool-disability program, kindergarten, or grades one through twelve a qualified student, with funds usable at any qualified nongovernmental school, matching the rung text "Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family."
